summary: Frontend-only mobile regression verified Unlimited settings, wording, setup/toss, below-25 board behavior, 25-point set transition, rules modal, theme toggle, and error-free rendering at 375x667.

issues: Active header formats Unlimited mode as BOARD 01 OF 00 because it stringifies boardsPerSet=0; this is misleading even though SeriesStatus correctly says Board 1 · unlimited.
Info card always says match cap is 25 points or 8 boards, which is inaccurate after selecting Unlimited mode.

action_items: Use an Unlimited-specific active header instead of BOARD N OF 00.
Make setup scoring/cap copy reflect the selected Unlimited setting, or move mode-specific explanation into settings.
critical_code_review_comments: Rules reference still states the fallback highest score is after 8 boards, which is not applicable to Unlimited mode; consider mode-specific rules copy.
AsyncStorage hydration forcibly overwrites persisted boardsPerSet with 8, so an Unlimited active match cannot survive a reload as Unlimited.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, clear localStorage before launch. Settings showed 1/3/5 sets, 8 boards, Unlimited, and only 25-point wording. Four 5-point completions stayed in SET 1 with Board 5 · unlimited and score 20; fifth advanced to SET 2 / Board 1 and reset score. Rules and theme controls passed.
rca_of_issue: Active() unconditionally builds its eyebrow from Math.min(match.board, match.boardsPerSet) and String(match.boardsPerSet), producing OF 00 for boardsPerSet=0. Setup info text is hardcoded. Hydration line 36 merges saved state but explicitly sets boardsPerSet: 8, discarding Unlimited persistence.
